players.product: PCIe Gen5 enterprise SSD controllers (X2 platform)

quarterly_data.signal: Phison 2Q26 results deck: revenue NT$67,888 million, up 65.7% QoQ, a single-quarter record; gross profit NT$44,335 million at a 65.3% gross margin (inventory write-downs reduced gross margin by approximately -1.10%); operating profit NT$26,370 million (operating margin 38.8%); net income to Phison NT$26,219 million and basic EPS NT$118.57, with equity-method investment gains contributing approximately +NT$14.22. First-half 2026: revenue NT$108.855 billion, gross margin 63.80%, EPS NT$187.43. 2Q26 revenue contribution: AI Ecosystem Module 38%, Embedded ODM Module 33%, Industrial Module 16%, Controller 6%, Retail Module 5%, Others 2%. Inventories NT$91,792 million at the end of 2Q26 (1Q26: NT$72,199 million).
quarterly_data.figure: 2Q26 revenue NT$67,888 million (+65.7% QoQ); gross margin 65.3%; EPS NT$118.57; 1H26 revenue NT$108.855 billion; inventories NT$91,792 million

quarterly_data.signal: Products Phison showed at COMPUTEX 2026 (per the 2Q26 deck): the D206V ultra-high-capacity Gen5 enterprise SSD at 245.76TB, which Phison calls the world's highest-capacity enterprise SSD; the PCIe Gen6 controller X3, supporting capacity up to 2PB with read/write performance up to 28000MB/s; the E37T PCIe Gen5 client SSD, which Phison calls the world's first DRAM-less Gen5 SSD to deliver 14.9GB/s; and UFS-enabled on-device AI pairing Phison Pascari aiDAPTIV with the MediaTek Dimensity 9500 to run large AI models directly on smartphones. Intel showcased its collaboration with Phison's aiDAPTIV SSD on its official channel.
quarterly_data.figure: D206V 245.76TB Gen5 eSSD; Gen6 controller X3 up to 2PB and 28000MB/s; E37T 14.9GB/s

quarterly_data.signal: aiDAPTIV business update (company): a 2H 2026 expansion takes the aiDAPTIV platform and delivery model proven in production in Taiwan global, with North America, Southeast Asia and India as first-wave markets through local channels and deployment partners. Next step: the Phison AI Data Platform, with which Phison says it will evolve from an AI user into an AI platform provider (an SME B2B AI on-prem total solutions provider). R&D expense was 22% of 1H26 revenue, with R&D headcount of 3,585 and R&D investment of NTD 24B+ in 1H26.
quarterly_data.figure: 2H 2026 expansion: North America, Southeast Asia, India; R&D 22% of 1H26 revenue
